reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is chat UX convenience: it augments the DSH Web message composer to quote selected chat text, show a lightweight preview, and inject a prefixed quote into outgoing content. Evidence from the README and package manifest indicates a client-side DSH web plugin with no declared external service, terminal, file, or data-processing integration.

summaries.zh: dsh-quote 是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件，可在聊天中选中文本后快速进行引用，并在输入区上方显示淡色提示，发送前自动将引用内容加入草稿。
summaries.en: dsh-quote is a DeepSeek Harness Web client plugin that lets you quote selected chat text and shows a faint preview, automatically adding the quote to your draft before sending.

capabilities: Adds a quote action in the chat UI when text is selected.
Displays a dismissible quote hint above the message composer.
Prepends a quote line to the message draft automatically on send-related actions.
Runs as a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin without declared runtime dependencies.
